data.gender_notes: Bazluke is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew Baal, meaning 'lord' or 'master'. The suffix '-luke' may indicate 'fighter' or 'strong one'. In the Bible, Baal was the name of various pagan deities and was worshiped through the burning of sacrifices. This name would be a reminder of God's ultimate power over all false gods and idols. The name Bazluke carries the meaning “Bold, warrior name” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bazluke usually hope their child will grow to embody bold, warrior name and live with faith, good character and purpose.
